start.subtitle: Guess the locations from the wedding photos!

how_to_play.step2: Mark your guess on the map
how_to_play.step3: Get points based on how close you are to the actual location
how_to_play.step4: The closer you are, the more points you get!

moderator.reset_confirm_text: Really reset the game? The current progress will be lost.

position_picker.point_hint: Tap the map, drag the marker, or enter the coordinates below.
position_picker.offline_map_notice: The offline map hasn't been downloaded yet – showing the online map instead.
position_picker.bbox_hint: Drag the corner handles, move/zoom the map and apply, or enter the map region below.

appearance.hide_labels_hint: Hides city, region, and country names on the game map so they don't give away the location while guessing.

round.mode_manual: Manual – the moderator ends the round with a click

map.hint: Set up map regions from coarse to fine - e.g. a low-detail world overview, then individual places in high detail. For every photo location (see round photos), high detail is automatically ensured on download, even if a region wouldn't otherwise cover it.
map.overview_hint: Shows at a glance which areas are already downloaded and which are only planned as a map region but not yet downloaded. The color shows the detail level. This overview map itself needs no downloaded map data and is always available, even fully offline.
map.overview_tooltip_planned: {name} – planned up to zoom {zoom} (not yet downloaded)
map.build_date_hint: Leave empty to automatically use the newest available build when downloading (recommended). Protomaps only keeps daily builds for about 5 days, so a date entered here will eventually become invalid. Only enter a date in YYYYMMDD format (e.g. 20260810) to pin a specific build - an overview of available dates is at
map.coverage_hint: Most detailed region: automatically expanded on download so every photo location is covered.

zoom.5: States / regions (world overview, a few MB)
zoom.10: City level, default (~1.4 GB for all of Europe)
zoom.11: Main road network (~2.9 GB for all of Europe)
zoom.12: Most roads (~6.5 GB for all of Europe)
zoom.13: Every side street (~13 GB for all of Europe)

progress.resolving_build_date: Looking up the newest available map build…

photos.hint: Any number of photos of the place to guess - no upper limit. When you pick a file, its GPS position (if present in the image data) is automatically filled into the position field; it can still be changed freely afterwards. The photo order sets the round order in the game - use the ↑/↓ arrows to change it at any time. This section is hidden by default and only appears after clicking the spoiler warning, so nothing is accidentally given away on a shared screen.
photos.spoiler_warning: This section contains the round photos.
photos.gps_hint_picked: Position chosen on the map – can still be adjusted if needed.
photos.gps_hint_searching: Looking for a position in the image data …
photos.gps_hint_found: Position taken from the image data – can be adjusted via the map if needed.
photos.gps_hint_not_found: No position found in the image data – please choose one via the map.
photos.missing_position_error: Please choose a position via the map.

host.hint: IP address and QR code that guests (e.g. on a tablet) can use to open the game directly on the same Wi-Fi. This section is hidden by default so the QR code isn't accidentally scanned by someone who isn't meant to join.
host.spoiler_warning: This section shows a QR code for joining.

danger.hint: Irreversibly resets player names, player photos, round photos, round timing settings, and the current game progress back to their shipped defaults. Map data, appearance, and the language setting are kept.
danger.confirm_message: This deletes all player and round photos, resets player names and round settings, and cannot be undone. Type "Where2Win" to confirm:
danger.success: The game has been reset to its default state.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.text: There are unsaved changes. If you leave now, they will be lost.
